objective: Responsive vanilla JS UI for sign in, incidents, notes import, draft review with citation highlighting, publish and postmortems (D1).
context: Built against spec sections 3, 7, 9 and src/api/contract-schemas.js. Hash routing, textContent-only rendering, no inline script or style (CSP default-src none; script-src self; style-src self). CSRF: GET /api/csrf before login, then the token from login/me is sent as X-CSRF-Token on non-GET; 401 UNAUTHENTICATED clears state and routes to sign-in. The task verification command checks public/app.js, so the entry module is public/app.js (loads js/api.js, js/dom.js, js/views/*, js/components/*) rather than the spec's js/main.js.
expectedOutput: public/ UI served by src/routes/static.js, a mock API for UI work, and a data-testid presence test.
acceptanceCriteria: Screens with loading, empty, error and success states
Citation chips highlight, scroll to and focus the source line; flagged statements show Not grounded with reasons; Publish disabled while flagged
Fallback banner when isFallback; no inline scripts; textContent only
completedWork: public/index.html, css/app.css, app.js, js/{api,dom}.js, js/views/{login,incidents,incident,postmortems}.js, js/components/{source,statements}.js; test/support/mock-api.js; test/unit/frontend/testids.test.js. Syntax check plus testid tests pass, and test/api/static.test.js now runs (previously skipped) and passes against the real public/index.html. No symlinks exist under public/. Not run in a browser: 360-1440 px layout, 44 px targets, focus outline, contrast and the full journey are unverified here and deferred to browser-e2e.
remainingIssues: Never run in a real browser by me; layout, contrast, touch-target, focus and journey checks are for browser-e2e (QA).
Viewer GET /api/providers and similar are not called by viewers; roles per spec 3.9 not independently verified against the live server.
Entry is public/app.js, not js/main.js as spec section 7 names it (task verification command requires app.js).
Regenerate replaces edits; UI warns in hint text only, no confirm step.
nextAction: qa-engineer: run test/browser journey against src/index.js with the data-testid list; security-reviewer: re-check static serving now that public/ exists.
